Memonta 9.5.3（143）
- 专业模式多选至少两笔纯录音后，右键新增「合并录音」。视频、录屏、笔记或混合选中时不显示此功能。 - 确认后按创建时间从早到晚连续拼接到最新一笔，保留最新录音的 ID、标题和创建时间，再删除较早录音。 - 转写时间戳按实际音轨时长顺延；总结按顺序合并，待办及已有提醒事项关联保留。兼容旧式根目录录音。 - 先导出并校验完整新文件，再保存和删除原件。失败时保留原件；目录交换支持回滚，删除失败可见提示并防止重复拼入。 - 合并时显示进度并阻止磁盘对账与更新安装冲突；完成后刷新播放器。新增文案支持 21 种界面语言。
验证：455 项单元测试回归通过；另在隔离数据上实测新旧目录的完整合并、最新条目身份保留、较早录音删除和磁盘对账。实际音频校验包括内容顺序、不同采样率、转写偏移、加密镜像、待办关联、原子回滚、提交后旧索引恢复及缺失音频/损坏待办时保留原件。未进行 Intel 真机与完整升级安装实测。
English
- Adds “Merge Recordings” to the Pro context menu when selecting at least two audio recordings. Videos, notes, and mixed selections are excluded. - Concatenates audio chronologically into the newest recording, retaining its identity, title, and creation date, then removes the older recordings after successful saving. - Adjusts transcript timestamps using actual audio durations, combines summaries, and preserves todos and existing reminder associations. Legacy root-level audio is supported. - Validates staged audio and encrypted mirrors before committing. Atomic directory swaps support rollback; interrupted commits recover audio pointers and complete merged transcripts/summaries from disk. Failed deletion is reported and duplicate inclusion is prevented. - Shows merge progress, coordinates disk sync and update installation, reloads playback, and includes translations for all 21 UI languages.
Validation: 455 unit tests passed, plus isolated end-to-end merge/deletion checks for current and legacy storage layouts and real-audio content checks. Intel hardware and a complete upgrade installation were not tested.
此版本沿用 9.5.1、9.5.2 的未公证分发方式，保留 Sparkle 更新签名。未经 Apple 公证，首次安装可能被 macOS 阻止，系统权限可能需要重新授予。
This release follows the same non-notarized distribution method as 9.5.1 and 9.5.2, with a Sparkle update signature. Initial installation may be blocked by macOS, and system permissions may need to be granted again.
